name: Cassiopeia
title: the Serpent's Embrace

Q.name: Noxious Blast
Q.description: Cassiopeia blasts noxious gas, Poisoning enemies and dealing 65/100/135/170/205 + 0.75×AP magic damage over 3 seconds. Hitting a champion grants Cassiopeia 30/35/40/45/50% Move Speed decaying over 3 seconds.
Q.summary: Cassiopeia blasts an area with Poison after a brief delay, granting her increased Move Speed if she hits an enemy champion.

W.name: Miasma
W.description: Cassiopeia spews venom, leaving toxic clouds for 5 seconds. Enemies in the clouds take 20/25/30/35/40 + 0.1×AP magic damage per second, are Poisoned, Grounded, and Slowed by 40/50/60/70/80%.
W.summary: Cassiopeia releases several clouds of poison, slowing, grounding, and lightly damaging enemies that pass through them. Grounded enemies cannot use Movement abilities.

E.name: Twin Fang
E.description: Cassiopeia launches deadly fangs, dealing 50+ (by level) + 0.2×AP magic damage. If the enemy is Poisoned, they take an additional 20/45/70/95/120 + 0.45×AP magic damage and Cassiopeia restores 0.1/0.115/0.13/0.145/0.16×AP Health, reduced to (0.1/0.115/0.13/0.145/0.16×AP) × 0.25 Health against lane minions and small monsters. If this kills the target, Cassiopeia restores (varies) Mana.
E.summary: Cassiopeia lets loose an attack that deals increased damage to Poisoned targets and heals her for a percentage of the damage dealt. If the target dies from this attack, Cassiopeia regains Mana.

R.name: Petrifying Gaze
R.description: Cassiopeia unleashes a petrifying gaze, dealing 125/225/325 + 0.75×AP magic damage and Stunning enemies facing her for 2 seconds. Enemies facing away are Slowed by 40% decaying over the same duration instead.
R.summary: Cassiopeia releases a swirl of magical energy from her eyes, stunning any enemies in front of her that are facing her and slowing any others with their back turned.

Passive.name: Serpentine Grace
Passive.description: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.
Passive.summary: All Move Speed bonuses are more effective on Cassiopeia.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Sustained-damage mage who stacks poison and spams E; W grounds dashes and R stuns those facing her.
strengths: Huge sustained damage with E on poisoned targets
R stun on those facing her
weaknesses: Vulnerable to burst and ranged poke
profile.curveNote: Needs Q to poison before E does real damage.

Q.notes: Delayed area poison; not a missile.

E.notes: Point-and-click missile; blockable by projectile blocks.

R.notes: Cone; stuns only those facing her: turning away turns it into a slow.

Passive.notes: Can't buy boots; move speed amplified.

profile.windowAgainst: W or R on cooldown, or she's out of mana before items.
checks: Passive: description only mentions move-speed bonuses; boot restriction not in the text.
